nodes.label: Grounded Architecture Synthesis
nodes.rationale: Architecture output must start from Archify artifacts, keep confirmed facts separate from inference, and avoid unsupported claims.

nodes.label: Archify Fact Policy
nodes.rationale: Confirmed, inferred, and missing-evidence statements must remain explicitly separated.

nodes.label: Visual Generation Gate
nodes.rationale: The downstream assistant must ask for artifact type and visual style, then wait for answers before generating architecture visuals.

nodes.label: Deterministic Progression
nodes.rationale: Tiers, rarity, power, energy, radius, and quest amounts are deterministic and avoid speculative randomness.

nodes.label: Location Privacy Boundary
nodes.rationale: Raw GPS is used only in request memory and must not be persisted in databases, logs, or analytics.

nodes.label: Testnet and Mock Asset Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Every relevant screen must identify Mock USDC, simulated yield, and demo/testnet limitations to avoid implying real financial value.

nodes.label: Limited Boilerplate Grounding
nodes.rationale: The initial repository contains mostly empty entry files, so no cross-boundary grounded links were detected.

nodes.label: On-Chain Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Game state is authoritative on Game L1 and asset accounting is authoritative on Fuji C-Chain; the backend database must not decide economic completion.
